nl.title: LiteSpeed Cache voor WordPress activeren via CyberPanel / OpenLiteSpeed
nl.excerpt: LiteSpeed Cache voor WordPress activeren via CyberPanel / OpenLiteSpeed: praktische handleiding in CyberPanel, met stappen, controles en wanneer je TripleZero iT support inschakelt.
nl.bodyHtml:
LiteSpeed Cache (LSCache) werkt optimaal op OpenLiteSpeed/CyberPanel en versnelt WordPress sterk als correct geconfigureerd.

Activeren

  1. Installeer de LiteSpeed Cache-plugin in WordPress.
  2. Bevestig dat de server OLS/LSWS is (CyberPanel standaard).
  3. Schakel page cache in; start met defaults.
  4. Sluit winkelwagen/account-pagina’s uit indien WooCommerce.
  5. Purge cache na deploy.

Tip: Bij rare layout na login: cache-variaties / exclude logged-in users controleren.

Heb je na het volgen van deze stappen nog vragen? Neem contact op met TripleZero iT support via het ticketssysteem. Vermeld hostname, CyberPanel-URL en wat je precies ziet (foutmelding of screenshot).

Gerelateerd: OpenLiteSpeed basics; rewrite/htaccess.

en.title: Enable LiteSpeed Cache for WordPress via CyberPanel / OpenLiteSpeed
en.excerpt: Enable LiteSpeed Cache for WordPress via CyberPanel / OpenLiteSpeed: backup, wp-admin, clear cache, verify.
en.bodyHtml:
For “Enable LiteSpeed Cache for WordPress via CyberPanel / OpenLiteSpeed” you work in WordPress (/wp-admin) on TripleZero iT hosting. Take a backup first; then change carefully and clear caches.

Preparation

  • Installatron or panel backup (files + database)
  • Login to /wp-admin of the correct site
  • DirectAdmin File Manager if wp-admin will not open

Steps

  1. Create a backup via Installatron or DirectAdmin.
  2. Sign in to /wp-admin.
  3. Apply the change in the correct menu: Plugins, Themes, Settings, Users, Media or WooCommerce.
  4. Save. On a critical error: via File Manager temporarily rename wp-content/plugins or activate a default theme.
  5. Clear page cache, object cache and CDN cache.
  6. Test the homepage, login and a critical flow (form or checkout).

Verify

  • No critical error
  • Change visible on the front end or in wp-admin

Tip: Change one plugin or theme at a time — faster rollback.

Note: Do not delete the uploads folder or database tables without a restore plan.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: Installatron backup, PHP version, critical error.
